constraints.hint: Adjust the syrup or water feed rates to hit targetThrow.
constraints.message: Water-to-syrup ratio is off target, so the beverage will be too sweet or too weak.

constraints.hint: Use a smaller bore (pipeDiameterMm) or more elements.
constraints.message: Flow is too slow for the elements to mix well; syrup may stratify.

constraints.hint: Use a larger bore.
constraints.message: Velocity is above the limit; expect erosion, noise and CO2 breakout downstream.

constraints.hint: Use fewer elements or a larger bore.
constraints.message: Pressure drop across the elements is more than the feed pressure can supply.

static-blender.description: Syrup joins treated water at a tee and passes through helical static-mixer elements, giving one uniform finished-beverage stream.
static-blender.name: Inline Static Blender M-101

parameters.description: Volume ratio of water to syrup. Assumed: confirm
parameters.label: Target throw (water:syrup)
parameters.name: targetThrow

constraints.hint: Raise columnPressurePsig or chill the blend further.
constraints.message: At this pressure and temperature the beverage cannot hold the target carbonation.

constraints.hint: Raise the CO2 supply.
constraints.message: Not enough CO2 is fed to reach the target carbonation.

constraints.hint: Chill the blend ahead of the carbonator.
constraints.message: The blend is too warm: it will lose CO2 and foam at the filler.

constraints.hint: Raise maxGpm (a larger column).
constraints.message: More beverage than the column is rated for.

derived.description: Volumes per atmosphere of CO2 at the beverage temperature.
derived.label: CO2 solubility
derived.name: solubilityVolPerAtm

carbonator.description: Chilled cola blend is sprayed into a pressurised contact column under a CO2 blanket. CO2 dissolves into the liquid to the target volumes; the gas it cannot hold is vented. Colder liquid and higher pressure hold more CO2 (Henry's law).
carbonator.name: Inline Carbonator C-101

parameters.description: Volumes of CO2 per volume of beverage. Cola is typically 3.5-4. Assumed: confirm
parameters.label: Target carbonation
parameters.name: targetVolumes

parameters.description: Share of the CO2 fed that dissolves; the rest vents.
parameters.label: CO2 absorbed
parameters.name: absorptionEff

parameters.description: Warmer than this and it foams at the filler.
parameters.label: Warmest beverage for filling
parameters.name: maxBeverageC

phaseChanges.description: CO2 dissolves into the chilled beverage.

constraints.hint: Increase workingVolumeGal.
constraints.message: The tank cannot hold the blender's output through a typical filler stop, so the blender has to stop too.

constraints.hint: Raise maxDrawGpm (bigger outlet nozzle).
constraints.message: The outlet cannot drain as fast as the tank is filled, so it will run full.

buffer-tank.description: Jacketed stainless buffer tank between blending and filling. Starts empty so only finished beverage reaches the filler.
buffer-tank.name: Beverage Buffer Tank T-101

parameters.description: About one filler repair. Assumed: confirm
parameters.label: Stop to ride through
parameters.name: minRideThroughMin

constraints.hint: Fit a bigger motor (motorKw) or lower the pressure rise.
constraints.message: Shaft power exceeds the motor rating; the motor will trip.

constraints.hint: Raise the tank level or suction pressure, or keep the product colder.
constraints.message: Available NPSH is below the required with margin; the pump will cavitate.

constraints.hint: Choose a larger pump.
constraints.message: Flow is above the pump's rated capacity.

filler-pump.description: Sanitary centrifugal pump lifting beverage from the buffer tank to the filler bowl at counter-pressure.
filler-pump.name: Sanitary Filler Feed Pump P-101

parameters.description: Filler bowl counter-pressure plus line losses. Assumed: confirm
parameters.label: Differential pressure
parameters.name: differentialPressureKpa

parameters.description: Atmosphere plus tank head. Assumed: confirm
parameters.label: Suction pressure (abs)
parameters.name: suctionPressureKpa

constraints.hint: Lower valveFlowMlPerS; add valves to keep the rate.
constraints.message: Valves fill faster than carbonated product can enter without foaming over.

constraints.hint: Chill the blend further upstream.
constraints.message: Product is too warm to hold its CO2 during filling; expect foaming and low fills.

constraints.hint: Raise pressurizeSeconds.
constraints.message: Too little time to pressurize and snift each bottle.

cp-filler.description: Rotary counter-pressure filler for carbonated soft drinks: bottles are pressurized with CO2, filled by gravity from the bowl, snifted and indexed out.
cp-filler.name: Counter-Pressure Rotary Filler FL-101

constraints.hint: Raise applyTorqueInLb.
constraints.message: Too little torque: the cap will not seal and the beverage loses CO2.

constraints.hint: Lower applyTorqueInLb.
constraints.message: Too much torque: the cap threads strip or the tamper band breaks.

constraints.hint: Slow the turret or add heads.
constraints.message: The turret is faster than the heads can pick caps reliably.

constraints.hint: Raise turretRpm or add heads.
constraints.message: The capper is slower than the filler, so the filler will be blocked.

rotary-capper.description: Filled bottles enter a star-wheel turret; each head picks a cap from the chute, spins it on, and a magnetic clutch stops it at the set torque. A torque monitor kicks out bottles whose cap did not seat.
rotary-capper.name: Rotary Screw Capper CA-101

parameters.description: 28 mm PCO 1881 cap on carbonated product. Assumed: confirm
parameters.label: Application torque
parameters.name: applyTorqueInLb

parameters.description: From the simulated filler. Assumed: confirm
parameters.label: Filler output
parameters.name: lineRatePerMin

constraints.hint: Lengthen the label or increase the overlap.
constraints.message: The label is shorter than the bottle circumference plus glue overlap, so it will not close.

constraints.hint: Slow the web or use a faster labeling head.
constraints.message: Web speed exceeds what the vacuum drum can transfer reliably.

wrap-labeler.description: Roll-fed wrap-around labeler: a vacuum drum cuts and glues a film label around each bottle; a vision camera rejects misapplied labels.
wrap-labeler.name: Wrap-Around Film Labeler LB-101

constraints.hint: Slow the belt or add side guides and a wider chain.
constraints.message: Belt is fast enough that empty-weight PET bottles tip at transfers.

constraints.hint: Lengthen the conveyor or add lanes.
constraints.message: Not enough accumulation to absorb a short case-packer stop at line rate.

accumulation-conveyor.description: Table-top chain conveyor that carries labeled bottles to the case packer and accumulates them back-to-back when the packer pauses.
accumulation-conveyor.name: Bottle Accumulation Conveyor CV-101

constraints.hint: Raise compressionSeconds or use a faster-setting adhesive.
constraints.message: Flaps leave compression before the hot-melt sets, so cases spring open.

constraints.hint: Raise laneRatePerMin or shorten the fold and compression times.
constraints.message: The packer is slower than the filler, so bottles back up the accumulation conveyor.

constraints.hint: Use more rows and fewer columns.
constraints.message: A long, narrow pack tips over on the collator.

wraparound-packer.description: Bottles are divided into one lane per pack row, collated, then a corrugated blank is folded around them and hot-melt sealed under compression. A check-weigher kicks out bad cases.
wraparound-packer.name: Lane-Fed Wrap-Around Case Packer CP-101

constraints.hint: Shorten the layer forming time or the pallet change.
constraints.message: The palletizer is slower than the case packer, so cases back up.

constraints.hint: Use fewer layers.
constraints.message: The load is taller than the hoist and the warehouse racking allow.

layer-palletizer.description: Cases are turned and rowed into a full layer on a forming table, a sweep pushes the layer onto the pallet, and the hoist steps down one layer. A full pallet leaves on the roller conveyor and an empty one comes in from the dispenser.
layer-palletizer.name: Low-Level Layer Palletizer PZ-101

parameters.description: 24 x 20 oz wrap-around tray. Assumed: confirm
parameters.label: Case height
parameters.name: caseHeightMm

parameters.description: From the simulated case packer. Assumed: confirm
parameters.label: Case packer output
parameters.name: caseRatePerMin
